shaping_additions.drawing: Four/five native-slant tremolo strokes in the native three-stroke area; thickness 56/40 font units; distinct separated strokes.
shaping_additions.shaping: Native normal/low positioning and count-specific stem-reordering reinsertion.

shaping_additions.drawing: Retain UFS OFL buzz-roll, bow-behind-bridge and bow-on-top-of-bridge ornaments; replace donor stem rectangle with each of seven native stem forms. Align stem centers and upper ends.
shaping_additions.shaping: Retain ornament identity through all native stem substitutions; copy native positioning, mark-to-base and cursive attachment.

shaping_additions.drawing: Clone the native U+09F0 outline under a distinct glyph identity.
shaping_additions.shaping: Expand native U+09AC input rules and attachment records; preserve all existing outputs.
shaping_additions.browser_compatibility: Shape-only BA plus U+E0150 selects the alternate drawing; canonically split O/AU vowels in affected drawing runs. Original input retained.

shaping_additions.drawing: Fit native DA to the native DDDA body band and retain the separate native implosive stroke.
shaping_additions.shaping: Expand native DDDA input rules and positioning; preserve existing outputs.
shaping_additions.browser_compatibility: Drawing-only DDDA plus U+E0160 selects the distinct alternate drawing; original logical input retained.

shaping_additions.drawing: OFL Shafarik caudate chrivi fitted uniformly to corresponding native case height; retained below-baseline tail and narrow proportions.
shaping_additions.shaping: Copy ordinary chrivi base mark anchors, translated to the new ink center; preserve native tilde/titlo and stacking.
shaping_additions.browser_compatibility: Within Glagolitic graphemes only, Cyrillic marks 0483/0484/0487 use inherited tilde plus E0170/E0171/E0172 drawing selectors to retain native glyphs and anchors across browser script itemization. Logical input remains unchanged.

shaping_additions.drawing: OFL UnicodiaFunky three-dot outline, centered over native candrabindu anchors. Four donor dots form a square for nukta+anusvara.
shaping_additions.shaping: Preserve native body shaping by filtering only nukta from original GSUB lookups; fuse it after native above-form composition, keeping repha/vowel bodies and native positioning. Dots clear combined bodies by 70 font units.
shaping_additions.provisional: Dense above-mark combinations require specialist and final comic-style review.

files.scope_note: The newer complete Dives Akuru font takes precedence. Exclude obsolete mapping at unassigned U+11939.
